mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqDailySourcingDbManageDetail*/ SELECT A.BUYER , DECODE(TRIM(A.PLANT), '', CP.COM_NAME_LOC, CP.COM_NAME_LOC || ' (' || A.PLANT || ')') AS BUYER_NAME , A.QUOTATION_NO , A.QUOTATION_SEQ , A.REVISION , A.KEP_QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_KEY , A.BTOA_DATE , A.BTOA_END_DATE , A.BTOA_USER_NAME , A.BTOA_USER_TEL , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = A.BTOA_USER_DEPT) AS BTOA_USER_DEPT , NVL(A.CMS_REJECT_FLAG, 'N') AS CMS_REJECT_YN , LR.USER_ID AS BTOA_USER_ID , A.DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.ITEM_QTY , A.UNIT_MEASURE , A.BTOA_REMARK , A.ATOA_REMARK , A.REMARK_URL , A.IMAGE_KEY , DECODE(A.IMAGE_PASS_FLAG, 'Y', '1', '0') AS IMAGE_PASS_FLAG , DECODE(NVL(A.PRE_GR_FLAG, 'Y'), 'Y', '1', '0') AS PRE_GR_FLAG , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = CP.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) = 0 THEN '' ELSE '4' END AS ITEM_GUBUN , A.MAKER_CODE , A.MAKER_NAME , NVL(A.MAKER_PART_NO, (SELECT MAKER_PART_NO FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = CP.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND STATUS IN ('C','R'))) AS MAKER_PART_NO , A.ORIGIN_CODE , OG.TEXT2 AS ORIGIN_NAME , SG.SG_NAME , (SELECT MAX(U.USER_NAME_LOC) FROM ICOMCOD3 C3, ICOMLUSR U WHERE C3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND C3.TYPE = 'CMSM' AND C3.CODE2 = '1' AND C3.FLAG = 'Y' AND C3.CODE1 = A.SG_ID AND U.USER_ID = TRIM(C3.TEXT1)) AS SM_MNG_NM , (SELECT MAX(U.USER_NAME_LOC) FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG Z, ICOMLUSR U WHERE Z.BUYER = A.BUYER AND Z.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND Z.STATUS = 'C' AND Z.MAIN_CLERK = 'Y' AND U.USER_ID = Z.KEP_USER_ID) AS BM_USER_NAME , (SELECT MAX(U.USER_NAME_LOC) FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG Z, ICOMLUSR U WHERE Z.BUYER = A.BUYER AND Z.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND Z.STATUS = 'C' AND Z.PRIORITY = 'Y' AND U.USER_ID = Z.KEP_USER_ID) AS MIS_BUYER_NAME , (SELECT Z.CATEG_PATH FROM CMSCATEG Z WHERE Z.CMS_CATEG_ID = A.CMS_CATEG_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS CATEG_PATH , DECODE(A.ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE, '', '', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE) || '(' || A.ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE || ')') AS ASSIGN_AGENT_NAME , DECODE(A.BUYER_ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE, '', '', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER_ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE)) AS BUYER_ASSIGN_AGENT_NAME , A.CMS_CATEG_ID , NVL(T.ATTR_CNT, 0) AS SPEC_CNT , T.ATTB1_NM AS SPEC_NM1 , T.ATTB1_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ1 , A.ATTB1_NM AS SPEC_VAL1 , T.ATTB2_NM AS SPEC_NM2 , T.ATTB2_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ2 , A.ATTB2_NM AS SPEC_VAL2 , T.ATTB3_NM AS SPEC_NM3 , T.ATTB3_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ3 , A.ATTB3_NM AS SPEC_VAL3 , T.ATTB4_NM AS SPEC_NM4 , T.ATTB4_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ4 , A.ATTB4_NM AS SPEC_VAL4 , T.ATTB5_NM AS SPEC_NM5 , T.ATTB5_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ5 , A.ATTB5_NM AS SPEC_VAL5 , T.ATTB6_NM AS SPEC_NM6 , T.ATTB6_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ6 , A.ATTB6_NM AS SPEC_VAL6 , T.ATTB7_NM AS SPEC_NM7 , T.ATTB7_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ7 , A.ATTB7_NM AS SPEC_VAL7 , T.ATTB8_NM AS SPEC_NM8 , T.ATTB8_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ8 , A.ATTB8_NM AS SPEC_VAL8 , T.ATTB9_NM AS SPEC_NM9 , T.ATTB9_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ9 , A.ATTB9_NM AS SPEC_VAL9 , T.ATTB10_NM AS SPEC_NM10 , T.ATTB10_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ10 , A.ATTB10_NM AS SPEC_VAL10 , T.ATTB11_NM AS SPEC_NM11 , T.ATTB11_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ11 , A.ATTB11_NM AS SPEC_VAL11 , T.ATTB12_NM AS SPEC_NM12 , T.ATTB12_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ12 , A.ATTB12_NM AS SPEC_VAL12 , T.ATTB13_NM AS SPEC_NM13 , T.ATTB13_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ13 , A.ATTB13_NM AS SPEC_VAL13 , T.ATTB14_NM AS SPEC_NM14 , T.ATTB14_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ14 , A.ATTB14_NM AS SPEC_VAL14 , T.ATTB15_NM AS SPEC_NM15 , T.ATTB15_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ15 , A.ATTB15_NM AS SPEC_VAL15 , T.ATTB16_NM AS SPEC_NM16 , T.ATTB16_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ16 , A.ATTB16_NM AS SPEC_VAL16 , T.ATTB17_NM AS SPEC_NM17 , T.ATTB17_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ17 , A.ATTB17_NM AS SPEC_VAL17 , T.ATTB18_NM AS SPEC_NM18 , T.ATTB18_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ18 , A.ATTB18_NM AS SPEC_VAL18 , T.ATTB19_NM AS SPEC_NM19 , T.ATTB19_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ19 , A.ATTB19_NM AS SPEC_VAL19 , T.ATTB20_NM AS SPEC_NM20 , T.ATTB20_FLAG AS SPEC_REQ20 , A.ATTB20_NM AS SPEC_VAL20 FROM KEPRQDT A LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCMPY CP ON (CP.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND CP.STATUS IN ('C','R')) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD1 OG ON (OG.TYPE = 'M001' AND OG.CODE = A.ORIGIN_CODE AND OG.FLAG = 'Y') LEFT OUTER JOIN KEPSGMG SG ON (SG.SG_ID = A.SG_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMLUSR LR ON (LR.USER_ID = A.BTOA_USER_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN CMSCATTR T ON (T.CMS_CATEG_ID = A.CMS_CATEG_ID) WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = #{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION = #{st_revision}
